event: Only coverpoints; no checks on the count registers. Submitting.

I submitted the verdict as verified: all five items stand as untested. I found no test or checker for the mailbox interrupt count-increment pulse fields or the counters they drive.

- **What I found:** Outside the generated register files, the only references are coverpoints in `src/mci/coverage/mci_top_cov_if.sv`. A coverpoint samples a value but cannot fail a test.
- **What I ruled out:** The `intr_count` matches in the C tests are unrelated. For example, `cptra_ss_mcu_mbox_test.c` only declares a local variable of that name.
- **Limits of the search:** I ran grep searches across `src/` and the repository. I read only `mci_reg.rdl` and the test file above. I did not open every test, so a test using different register names could have slipped through.
- **Per-item note:** The record has a short search entry for each of the five items. Most of them are grep-only checks.
